prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Wholesale pricing review
client: Coastline Hardware
client_industry: wholesale
start: 2024-07
end: 2024-09
engagement: hourly
stack:
- SQL
- Excel
- Python
implied_skills:
- margin analysis
built: Compared cost, price and volume for 300 SKUs and proposed new price bands.
metrics:
- 300 SKUs repriced
- gross margin +2.3 points

The review is from: Coastline Hardware
Rating: 4.5 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on technical quality; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "margin analysis".
text: Mina did solid work on our wholesale pricing review. She was careful with the SQL, Excel, and Python work behind the scenes, and the pricing recommendations were well supported by the data. She helped us reprices 300 SKUs and we saw gross margin improve by 2.3 points. Would work with her again on similar analysis.
